maya: Morning team — quick async bridgesync for pipeline + security escalations. TL;DR: Kestrel needs KMS validation, Nova pilot needs quota bump for perf tests, Orion PoC awaiting legal dataflow. Drop what you did / blockers / today below. :eyes:

dan: Kestrel update — requested a test key from infra (ticket #INC-4782). Security flagged keywrap vs HSM; infra says HSM timeline is 3-5 business days. Blocker for demo until we get a test vector.

ashley: Nova pilot — perf team needs 2x Dedicated slots for end-to-end latency runs. Ops asked for committed usage numbers; I pushed a short proposal to the deal doc (link). Blocker: quota approval from infra.

jorge: Orion PoC — legal asked for a dataflow diagram and DPIA notes. I recorded a 3min Loom and uploaded it to the deal folder. ETA for legal ack is end of day.

liam: quick CR ping for my PR #432 (routing fallback + logging tweaks) — needs one more reviewer before I can merge and redeploy. Small change, low risk.

maya: I'll take the CR after breakfast. Also, can someone run a basic health check against the staging endpoint for Kestrel so security can reproduce the issue? e.g.:
```sh
curl -I https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/kestrel/health
```

dan: ran the curl, got 200 but TLS cert is expired on the test endpoint — raising a follow-up with infra. That might explain some of the validation failures.

ashley: blocker to note — EU customer asked for on-prem audit checklist; we don't have the current checklist linked in the deal doc. Priya, can you share the compliance checklist or a pointer? :pray:

priya: looping in sec team. I'll drop the SSO/KMS/HSM checklist and the required config matrix in the deal doc by 12:30pm. Also confirming whether HSM is mandatory or optional for Kestrel (will confirm).

sec-bot: FYI — security flagged Kestrel (customer: Kestrel Health) for potential HSM requirement on 2026-03-16. See ticket SEC-991 for details.

jorge: noted. For Orion legal, I added a short appendix describing what data is stored transiently vs logged. Happy to iterate.

liam: if we can get one reviewer on #432 and infra fixes cert + test key, I can run the pilot perf tests this afternoon.

maya: Plan for today: 1) Priya to post checklist (by 12:30). 2) Dan to follow up infra cert + test key. 3) Ashley to confirm committed usage proposal with product (ETA 3pm). 4) Liam to merge after review and start perf runs (afternoon). 5) Jorge to monitor legal. Ping here with any changes. :thumbsup:

ashley: acked. I'll also add the EU audit checklist placeholder so legal can see doc location.

dan: following up with infra now, will update thread when ticket moves.

priya: on it — will post checklist + quick remediation steps for HSM vs KMS by noon.

maya: thanks — if anything becomes urgent, escalate in #incidents. Otherwise we'll reconvene in the afternoon sync if needed.

(security-bot reaction): :white_check_mark:
